conversation.content: Let's start a production plan for a run that needs to yield 2,500 usable brackets.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan", "value": {"usable_unit_target": 2500}}]
Assume the bracket process normally loses 8% of started pieces to trimming and inspection rejects.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/scrap_rate_percent", "value": 8}]
Use the usual planning rule for this: divide the good-piece target by the expected yield and round up to the next whole bracket.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/formulas", "value": {"raw_units_required": "ceil(usable_unit_target / (1 - scrap_rate_percent / 100))"}}]
Go ahead and calculate how many brackets we need to start based on that rule.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/raw_units_required", "value": 2718}]
Also show expected lost pieces as the difference between what we start and what we need to ship.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/formulas/waste_units_estimate", "value": "raw_units_required - usable_unit_target"}]
Please fill in that expected loss number now.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/waste_units_estimate", "value": 218}]
Use $4.75 for each blank we put into the line.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/costing", "value": {"material_unit_cost": 4.75}}]
For the material spend, calculate it as started blanks times that blank price.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/formulas/material_total_cost", "value": "raw_units_required * material_unit_cost"}]
Please put in the current material spend for that calculation.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/costing/material_total_cost", "value": 12910.5}]
Add $1.20 of variable shop labor for every bracket started.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/costing/variable_labor_unit_cost", "value": 1.2}]
Calculate the variable labor spend the same way, using started brackets times the labor amount.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/formulas/variable_labor_total_cost", "value": "raw_units_required * variable_labor_unit_cost"}]
Please fill in the current variable labor spend from that calculation.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/costing/variable_labor_total_cost", "value": 3261.6}]
Add a $0.35 press lubricant and tooling allowance for every bracket we start.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/costing/consumable_unit_cost", "value": 0.35}]
Calculate that allowance as started brackets times the allowance amount.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/formulas/consumable_total_cost", "value": "raw_units_required * consumable_unit_cost"}]
Please fill in the current allowance spend.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/costing/consumable_total_cost", "value": 951.3}]
Now roll those three variable spending lines into one production cost total.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/formulas/variable_production_total_cost", "value": "material_total_cost + variable_labor_total_cost + consumable_total_cost"}]
Please fill in that rolled-up variable production cost now.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/costing/variable_production_total_cost", "value": 17123.4}]
Include a flat $900 setup charge for this run as well.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/costing/fixed_setup_cost", "value": 900}]
Make the overall run cost add the variable production total and the setup charge.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/formulas/total_run_cost", "value": "variable_production_total_cost + fixed_setup_cost"}]
Please fill in the overall run cost using that setup charge.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/costing/total_run_cost", "value": 18023.4}]
Tag the plan with the job identity: work order WO-24-1187 for the left-hand mounting bracket, revision C.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/order_info", "value": {"work_order_id": "WO-24-1187", "product_name": "left-hand mounting bracket", "product_revision": "C"}}]
Add the timing for the run: release it on March 4, start production on March 11, and have it ready to ship by March 18, 2024.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/schedule", "value": {"release_date": "2024-03-04", "planned_start_date": "2024-03-11", "ship_due_date": "2024-03-18"}}]
Note that this will run at Cleveland Plant 2 in Stamping Cell 4 on Press Line B.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/production_site", "value": {"plant": "Cleveland Plant 2", "work_center": "Stamping Cell 4", "line": "Press Line B"}}]
Add the material callout: galvanized steel sheet, grade G90, at 2.5 mm thickness.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/material_specification", "value": {"material": "galvanized steel sheet", "grade": "G90", "thickness_mm": 2.5}}]
Add the inspection plan: use the fixture gauge, check one bracket every 50 pieces, and document it on form QF-17.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/quality_plan", "value": {"inspection_gauge": "fixture gauge", "sampling_frequency": "1 per 50 pieces", "record_form": "QF-17"}}]
Add the packaging instructions: 100 brackets per returnable tote, with foam dividers, and label them for customer dock D12.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/packaging", "value": {"pack_quantity": 100, "pack_type": "returnable tote with foam dividers", "destination_label": "customer dock D12"}}]
Assign the run to first shift, with Maria Chen supervising and Owen Patel handling planning follow-up.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/assignments", "value": {"shift": "first shift", "supervisor": "Maria Chen", "planner": "Owen Patel"}}]
Record the tooling for the run: die set DS-44, tool revision 6, and preventive maintenance current through March 31, 2024.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/tooling", "value": {"die_set_id": "DS-44", "tool_revision": "6", "maintenance_valid_through": "2024-03-31"}}]
Add the safety notes for the cell: cut-resistant gloves are required, hearing protection is required, and lockout must be verified before die adjustment.

[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/safety_requirements", "value": {"gloves": "cut-resistant gloves required", "hearing_protection": "required", "lockout_note": "verify lockout before die adjustment"}}]
Finish it with the approval details: approved by Dana Brooks, approved on March 1, 2024, and currently released for production.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/manufacturing_plan/approval", "value": {"approved_by": "Dana Brooks", "approval_date": "2024-03-01", "status": "released for production"}}]

edit_instruction: Update the planned scrap allowance to 10%.
conversation_pattern: Center the artifact on a manufacturing plan with a stated scrap rate, usable-unit target, raw-unit requirement, waste estimate, and cost totals where raw demand derives from the target and scrap rate by stated formulas. Around this core, add the realistic, independent details a production record would carry that do not depend on scrap rate, and vary their number from sample to sample.
edit_pattern: Change the scrap rate to a specific new percentage.
cascade_pattern: Editing the scrap rate re-derives raw units required, waste estimate, and any cost totals that depend on raw demand from the stated formulas. The usable-unit target and per-unit costs stay unchanged.
